bools.name: dgbT2OpenDoorsRetry
bools.comment: Table 2 explanation (capture p. 8): a stuck door can be retried until it opens, each attempt noisy and slow

bools.name: dgbT2LockedOneAttempt
bools.comment: Table 2 explanation (capture p. 8): a locked, barred or magically held door allows one attempt ever - a failure is permanent for that character

bools.name: dgbT2BendBarsOneAttempt
bools.comment: Table 2 explanation (capture p. 8): a failed bend-bars or lift-gate attempt can never succeed at that task; the other task at the same gate stays open

bools.name: dgbT2DmgFloorOne
bools.comment: Table 2 explanation (capture p. 8): a successful hit never causes less than 1 point of damage

bools.name: dgbT2WeightSlowdown
bools.comment: Table 2 explanation (capture p. 8): each additional 350 coins (35 lbs.) of weight slows the character by 25 percent

bools.name: dgbT4HitDieFloorOne
bools.comment: Table 4 explanation (capture p. 10): no hit die ever yields fewer than 1 hit point, whatever the adjustment

bools.name: dgbT4WarriorFullCon
bools.comment: Table 4 footnote (capture p. 10): the +3 at Constitution 17 and +4 at 18 apply only to samurai, bushi, kensai and sohei

bools.name: dgbT4BarbarianFullCon
bools.comment: Table 4 footnote (capture p. 10): the barbarian also receives the full hit-point bonus for Constitution

bools.name: dgbT4OthersCapTwo
bools.comment: Table 4 footnote (capture p. 10): wu jen, shukenja, ninja and yakuza receive at most +2 per hit die at Constitution 18

bools.name: dgbT6MindAuto
bools.comment: Table 6 explanation (capture p. 11): the magical attack adjustment applies automatically against mind attacks - beguiling, charm, fear, hypnosis, illusion, possession, suggestion

chains.name: dgbT8Band
chains.comment: the Table 8 band chain (capture p. 13): a Charisma score maps to its band - 2 or less band 0, 3 band 1, 4-5 band 2, 6-8 band 3, 9-12 band 4, 13-15 band 5, 16-17 band 6, 18 band 7, 19 or more band 8

tables.name: dgbT2Grid
tables.comment: the Table 2 Strength Adjustments grid (capture p. 8)
col_comments: the hit probability column: -3 at Strength 3 to +3 at 18/00 and 19 (capture p. 8).
the damage adjustment column: -1 at Strength 3 to +7 at 19 (capture p. 8).
the weight allowance column in coins: 0 at Strength 3 (the printed zero, pinned as printed) to 4,850 at 19 (capture p. 8).
the open-doors max column: the highest d6 face that forces a stuck door; the Str 19 row prints 7-in-8, pinned as the face 7 (capture p. 8).
the open-doors locked column: the parenthetical chance on a locked, barred or held door - 0 except 1 at 18/91-99, 2 at 18/00, 3 at 19 (capture p. 8).
the bend-bars percent column: 0 at Strength 3 to 50 at 19 (capture p. 8).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 2 grid: hit probability, damage adjustment, weight allowance, open-doors max and locked, bend-bars percent across the sixteen Strength rows (capture p. 8)

tables.name: dgbT3Grid
col_comments: the reaction/attacking adjustment column: -3 at Dexterity 3 to +3 at 19 (capture p. 9).
the defensive adjustment column: +4 at Dexterity 3 to -4 at 19 (capture p. 9).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 3 grid: the reaction adjustment and the defensive adjustment across Dexterity 3-19 (capture p. 9)

tables.name: dgbT4Grid
col_comments: the hit-point adjustment column: -2 at Constitution 3 to +2 at 18 (capture p. 10).
the warrior hit-point column: the full bonus ladder - the +3 at Constitution 17 and +4 at 18 of the printed footnote (capture p. 10).
the system shock survival percent column: 35 at Constitution 3 to 99 at 18 (capture p. 10).
the resurrection survival percent column: 40 at Constitution 3 to 100 at 18 (capture p. 10).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 4 grid: the hit-point and warrior hit-point adjustments, the system shock and resurrection survival percents across Constitution 3-18 (capture p. 10)

tables.name: dgbT5Grid
col_comments: the additional languages column: 0 at Intelligence 3-7, 1 at 8-9, rising to 7 at 18 (capture p. 11).
the maximum wu jen spell level column: 4 at Intelligence 3-9, 5 at 10-11, 6 at 12-14, 7 at 15, 8 at 16-17, 9 at 18 (capture p. 11).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 5 grid: the additional languages and the maximum wu jen spell level across Intelligence 3-18 (capture p. 11)

tables.name: dgbT6Grid
col_comments: the magical attack adjustment column: -3 at Wisdom 3 to +4 at 18 (capture pp. 11-12).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 6 grid: the magical attack adjustment across Wisdom 3-18 (capture pp. 11-12)

tables.name: dgbT7Grid
col_comments: the maximum henchmen column: 1 at Charisma 3-4 rising to 15 at 18 (capture p. 12).
the loyalty base percent column: -30 at Charisma 3 to +40 at 18 (capture p. 12).
the reaction adjustment percent column: -25 at Charisma 3 to +35 at 18 (capture p. 12).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 7 grid: the henchmen, loyalty base and reaction adjustment columns across Charisma 3-18 (capture p. 12)

tables.name: dgbT8Grid
tables.comment: the Table 8 Comeliness Adjustments grid (capture p. 13)
col_comments: the band-max column: the highest Charisma score of each band - 2, 3, 5, 8, 12, 15, 17, 18, and the 19-plus tail (capture p. 13).
the Comeliness adjustment column: -8 at Charisma 2 or less, -5 at 3, -3 at 4-5, -1 at 6-8, 0 at 9-12, +1 at 13-15, +2 at 16-17, +3 at 18, +5 at 19 or more (capture p. 13).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 8 grid: the nine Charisma bands and their Comeliness adjustments (capture p. 13)

banner.title: THE ABILITY TABLES, printed capture pp. 7-13 - the OA Chapter 1 ability tables round
banner.provenance: verified against capture pp. 7-13 of the oa.pdf OCR session (single Mistral-OCR capture; cites are capture pages). OCR normalizations: the Table 4 "+" and percent spacing read clean as numbers; the Table 5 korobokuru maximum splits from its Intelligence 15 row in the capture and merges back per book-internal settling; Table 2 Strength 3 weight allowance prints 0 - pinned as printed, flagged for the physical copy. The open-doors parentheticals pin as their own column (the engine strOpenDoors precedent); the Str 19 row prints 7-in-8 and pins as the face 7. The Table 4 footnote prints the warrior bonus (+3 at Con 17, +4 at 18) for samurai, bushi, kensai and sohei with the barbarian also entitled - all pinned as printed.
